bias.en: Uptrend · back above the 5-day, capped near $414
bias.zh: 上升趋势 · 重回 5 日均线上方，$414 附近受阻

read.en: Tesla rose 1.0% on Nov 2 to $403.82, trading between $397.61 and $414.23. It is just above the rising 5-day ($403.7) and above the rising 10-day ($391.7), 30-day ($377.2) and 100-day ($368.1) and the falling 200-day ($385.1). MACD has been above its signal since Oct 26 and above zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Oct 21 ($373.79), and RSI is 62.
read.zh: 特斯拉 11月2日上涨 1.0%，收于 $403.82，盘中区间 $397.61–414.23。股价略高于上行的 5 日均线（$403.7），并位于上行的 10 日（$391.7）、30 日（$377.2）和 100 日均线（$368.1）以及下行的 200 日均线（$385.1）上方。MACD 自 10月26日起位于信号线上方且在零轴之上，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月21日起看多（$373.79），RSI 为 62。

read.en: The close reclaimed the $401.3–404.2 resistance and the 5-day; the high of $414.2 pushed through the $409.3–410.9 highs before fading back under them. Resistance is $409.3–410.9 (Apr 17 and Oct 28 highs), then $416.4–420.3 and $424.4–424.7 (June highs). Support is $395.3–397.6, then $385.1–388 ($388 cap, 200-day, Oct 30 low) and $377.2–377.6. A close above $411 would target $416–420; below $395, $388.

r.en: Apr 17 high $409.3; Oct 28 high $410.85; Nov 2 high $414.2

s.en: $388 cap since March; 200-day average $385.1; Oct 30 low $387.5
